name: State Level (S)
description: Seats open to Maharashtra-domicile candidates statewide

name: Home University (H)
description: Seats reserved for candidates from the college's home university region

name: Other Than Home University (O)
description: Seats for Maharashtra candidates from other university regions

name: All India (AI)
description: Seats filled on JEE Main rank, open to candidates from all states

name: Minority (MI)
description: Minority-institution seats, shown in a separate list

name: Exam to seat flow
description: MHT CET percentile -> CAP merit list -> option form -> CAP rounds I to IV -> seat acceptance -> reporting

name: Cutoff output
description: CET Cell publishes closing merit rank and percentile per college, branch, category and seat type after each round, separately for MH and AI seats
